_purpose: Pre-registered 500-target cohort for the v0.24 coverage-mode formal-TEST confirmation protocol. Committed before any search is run against these targets -- selection is a deterministic function of the corpus content alone, not influenced by any observed route-search outcome.
selection_rule: sample_key = SHA256(protocol_version + '|' + canonical_smiles), RDKit canonicalization, sorted ascending by (sample_key, canonical_smiles), first N taken as a prefix.
